Gallade

Psychic Fighting

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Gallade is a Psychic/Fighting-type Blade Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 52 kg. It evolves from Kirlia. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 518.
